baseGrid._note: 12-column newspaper/magazine editorial base. Tight 18px gutters keep type in primary focus. Derived from griting-formless 12-column layout canon.

prose._description: Reading-optimised single prose column. 680px max-width centred. Tuned for body text at 16-18px yielding a comfortable ~70-character line length. No column subdivisions — pure reading rail. Typography-first default for longform content.

display._description: Full-width unconstrained display layout. Type bleeds to edges with no max-width constraint. Used for oversized display headlines, wordmark lockups, and full-bleed hero sections. Derived from formless-full-width-lockup DNA.

two-column-editorial._description: Unequal magazine editorial split. Left column 2fr (caption, pull-quote, section label, date), right column 3fr (body text, subheading, narrative content). Derived from griting-formless gritme-feature 40fr/60fr asymmetric pattern, recast as fraction-based editorial ratio with 18px tight gutter.

two-column-editorial-alt._description: Narrow editorial split for index and listing contexts. Left column 1fr (issue number, category label, byline, timestamp), right column 2fr (headline and teaser body). Used for article index pages, blog rolls, and numbered section headers.

formless-editorial._description: Formless-inherited premium whitespace editorial column with 244px gutters on both sides. Used for text-heavy sections requiring maximum breathing room. Signals quality through restraint. Container max-width 1520px/40px takes precedence.

formless-two-col-split._description: Equal two-column baseline-aligned split from formless vocabulary. Both columns 1fr. Items align to flex-end creating a shared baseline between a large heading/CTA on the left and body text on the right. Gap 48px.

formless-sticky-scroll._description: Three sequential sticky panels with 80px gap and thin vertical rule divider. Left column: large visual. Right column: oversized numeral, service title, body copy.

formless-4col-flex-wrap._description: Wrappable 4-column flex row with 32px gap and center justification. For 4-up card grids and pillar sections.

formless-overlapping-grid._description: Three-column overlapping staggered card grid. Cards given vertical offsets for non-uniform editorial rhythm. Display headline spans full width above.

formless-full-width-lockup._description: Full-viewport-width brand lockup. Type bleeds edge to edge. Opens and closes the page as a visual frame.

hero._note: Full-bleed dark bg. Headline anchored to grid columns 1-10 for editorial weight. Use .layout-display for pure type-bleed variant.

gritme-feature._note: Typography-first editorial recast of original 40fr/60fr. 2fr text left / 3fr visual right. Matches .layout-two-column-editorial.

bodyCopy._note: Wider than prose variant (680px). Griting-formless original retained for about-us body copy fidelity.

fullBleed.description: Background layers and CTA sections spanning full 1520px+

productSection._note: Editorial unequal split: 1fr numbered scroll-nav list / 2fr content panel. Derived from griting-formless ~33/60 product section.

partnerContent._note: Partners asymmetric editorial split matching two-column-editorial variant ratio.

micro-grid-overlay.description: Holographic foil cell pattern overlay — 16-column micro-grid subdivides the layout surface into iridescent cell zones. Opacity 0.07.

responsive._note: Desktop-first. Primary canvas 1520px. Mobile collapses to single column with 28px side padding for comfortable type reading margins.

bp-375px._note: Single column. 28px side padding. All multi-column layouts collapse. Prose and display variants remain active.
